input.title: Aventon Current EXP
input.descriptionHtml:
Aventon Current EXP full-suspension eMTB carbon front triangle, Aventon Ultro X mid-drive motor, RockShox Lyrik fork, RockShox Super Deluxe shock, SRAM Maven brakes & S1000 wireless transmission. Ava

Aventon Current EXP
Full-Suspension Carbon eMTB

 

The Aventon Current EXP is a purpose-built full-suspension eMTB that brings genuine trail capability to an accessible price point. A carbon front triangle paired with a 6061 aluminum rear triangle keeps weight down to 53 lbs while delivering the stiffness and compliance riders expect from a dedicated mountain platform. The geometry is trail-specific - 64.6 head angle, 76.6 seat tube angle, 445mm chainstays, and 29" wheels - giving the Current a planted, confident feel on descents while staying efficient and capable on climbs.

Power comes from Aventon's Ultro X mid-drive motor, producing 110Nm of torque (120Nm in Boost Mode) with up to 400% support (500% in Boost) and an 800Wh integrated battery good for up to 105 miles of range. The connected platform delivers 4G/GPS tracking, anti-theft, Air Time tracking, Wheel Lift Control, Overrun, Auto Assist Mode, and a customizable integrated touchscreen display - all managed through the Aventon app with over-the-air updates. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Current EXP is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Sizing:

  • Small - under 5'3"
  • Medium - 5'3" to 5'7"
  • Large - 5'7" to 6'1"
  • Extra Large - over 6'1"
 

Key components:

  • RockShox Lyrik Select fork - 150mm travel, 44mm offset
  • RockShox Super Deluxe Select+ rear shock - 210x55mm, 140mm rear travel
  • XFusion Manic dropper seatpost - 150mm (S/M) / 170mm (L/XL)
  • SRAM Maven Base 4-piston hydraulic disc brakes - SRAM Centerline 200mm rotors
  • SRAM S1000 Transmission 12-speed - wireless AXS Shift Pod
  • SRAM T-Type 34T chainring - SRAM XS-1270 T-Type 10-52T cassette
  • Maxxis Minion DHF 29x2.5" EXO front / Maxxis Minion DHR II 29x2.4" EXO rear - tubeless ready
  • ISIS 160mm crankset
